title: Neighborhood Watch Log Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neighborhood:watch
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by patrol_zone
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when neighborhood watch log data has stopped arriving for a given patrol zone.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per patrol zone and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your neighborhood watch log feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
